description: This file defines the RemoteDispatcher interface for remote service invocation in the Apache OFBiz framework, including methods for synchronous, asynchronous, and scheduled service execution.

classes.name: RemoteDispatcher
classes.description: Interface for remote service dispatching, supporting synchronous, asynchronous, and scheduled execution.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Run a service synchronously and return the result.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Run a service synchronously with a timeout and transaction control.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Run a service synchronously and ignore the result.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Run a service synchronously with a timeout and ignore the result.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Run a service asynchronously with a requester, with options for persistence and transaction control.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Run a service asynchronously with a requester, with persistence option.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Run a service asynchronously with a requester, with persistence (default).

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Run a service asynchronously without a requester, with persistence option.

methods.description: Run a service asynchronously without a requester, ignoring the result.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Run a service asynchronously without a requester, ignoring the result, with persistence.

methods.name: runAsyncWait
methods.description: Run a service asynchronously and wait for the result, with persistence option.

methods.name: runAsyncWait
methods.description: Run a service asynchronously and wait for the result, with persistence.
